analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 (102,377/112,663 KRW): indicating strong mid/long-term bearish trend.

· MACD histogram trajectory (340.0387→137.1785): improving but still negative + bearish reversal signal unconfirmed.

· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (potential Higher Low formation): awaiting trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): buy entry contingent on confirmed MACD improvement and RSI rebound.
